# StackSolver UK

> StackSolver UK Limited is an independent cyber security, governance, risk and compliance consultancy based in Brighton, for regulated industries. **Cyber security is our specialty.** Serving the **United Kingdom, Europe and the United States**. Senior expertise. Lean delivery. Auditable by design.

**Official site:** https://www.stacksolveruk.com
**All services:** https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services
**About:** https://www.stacksolveruk.com/about
**Contact:** hello@stacksolveruk.com · https://www.stacksolveruk.com/contact
**Registered office:** 215 Ditchling Road, Brighton, BN1 6JD, United Kingdom
**Company Number:** 16227080 (England and Wales)

## How we work

- Senior practitioners only: no junior staff billed at senior rates.
- Cyber security at the core: control, evidence and audit trail under everything we do.
- Fixed fees where scope is clear: you know what it costs before we start.
- Compliance by design: risk registers, evidence and audit trails from week one.
- Independent: we do not resell tools we cannot defend.

## Services — six areas

### Cyber Security (our specialty)
Certify, test, respond. https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#cyber
- [Cyber Essentials Plus](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#cyber-essentials-plus): enter corporate procurement with the badge UK buyers expect.
- [Penetration Testing](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#penetration-testing): independent security testing of your web applications, networks and cloud.
- [Virtual CISO (vCISO)](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#vciso-retainer): senior security leadership on retainer, without the cost of a full-time hire.
- [Security Architecture](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#security-architecture): Zero Trust, identity, network segmentation and cloud security design.
- [Incident Response](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#incident-response): on-call retainer, playbook development and tabletop exercises.
- [Security Awareness](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#security-awareness): phishing simulation, e-learning and culture programmes.

### Governance
Oversight and accountability. https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#governance
- [Gap Analysis & Maturity Assessment](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#gap-analysis): where you are vs where you need to be, with a prioritised remediation roadmap.
- [Internal Audit](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#internal-audit): pre-certification dry-runs and ongoing internal audit programmes for ISO standards.
- [DPO-as-a-Service](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#dpo-as-service): outsourced Data Protection Officer aligned with UK GDPR and DPA 2018.

### Risk
Registers, suppliers, resilience. https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#risk
- [Risk Assessment & Risk Register](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#risk-assessment): the risk register that auditors and boards expect to see.
- [Third-Party Risk Management](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#tprm-programme): vendor risk programme design and operations.
- [DORA Readiness](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#dora-readiness): Digital Operational Resilience Act compliance for financial entities and ICT third-party providers.
- [UK Operational Resilience](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#operational-resilience-uk): Bank of England SS1/21 important business services and resilience scenarios.
- [ISO 22301 (Business Continuity)](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#iso-22301-bcm): Business Continuity Management System for resilience and DORA alignment.
- [TLPT (Threat-Led Penetration Testing)](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#tlpt-testing): threat-led penetration testing for significant financial entities.

### Compliance
ISO, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2. https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#compliance
- [ISO/IEC 27001:2022](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#iso-27001): Information Security Management System: implementation, certification support, surveillance.
- [ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy)](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#iso-27701-privacy): Privacy Information Management System extending ISO 27001 with GDPR alignment.
- [SOC 2 Type I & II](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#soc-2): for UK firms selling to the United States: readiness, evidence and CPA coordination.
- [GDPR & UK GDPR](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#gdpr-uk-gdpr): compliance programmes for organisations handling personal data in the UK and EU.
- [NIS2 Readiness](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#nis2-readiness): gap assessment and implementation for the NIS2 Directive, for UK firms with EU operations.

### HR & Recruitment
Contracts, onboarding, payroll. https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#hr
- [HR Advisory & Documentation](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#hr-advisory): contracts, policies and handbooks for small and growing teams.
- [Onboarding & Offboarding](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#hr-onboarding): structured onboarding and offboarding, done properly and on time.
- [Payroll & Benefits Coordination](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#hr-payroll-benefits): coordination of payroll, pensions and benefits with your providers.

### Business Systems
ERP, FileMaker, support. https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#systems
- [Claris FileMaker ERP](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#claris-filemaker-erp): custom ERP and business applications built on Claris FileMaker, in one auditable system.
- [ERP Consulting & Migration](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#erp-consulting-migration): independent, platform-neutral advice on ERP selection and migration, including NetSuite.
- [Support & Continuous Improvement](https://www.stacksolveruk.com/services#business-systems-support): ongoing support, enhancements and continuous improvement for your business systems.

## Who we work with

Regulated industries across the United Kingdom, Europe and the United States: technology, professional services, financial services, healthcare and corporate services.
